title: The Granularity Axis: A Micro-to-Macro Latent Direction for Social Roles in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.06196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are prompted to adopt social roles from individuals to institutions, but whether their representations encode this difference in social granularity remains unclear. We discover a contrast-based Granularity Axis, the difference between mean macro- and micro-role hidden states, that aligns with the dominant geometry of role space: in Qwen3-8B, its cosine with PC1 is $0.972$, and PC1 explains $52.6\%$ of the variance. Across 75 roles at five levels, with 90,000 role-conditioned and 1,200 default responses per model, projections increase monotonically and remain stable across layers, prompts, and response-quality filters. The structure transfers to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and scales to Qwen3-32B and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, whose PC1 shares are $45.99\%$ and $31.23\%$. translated_title: 粒度轴：语言模型中社会角色的微观到宏观潜在方向
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常被提示采纳从个人到机构等各种社会角色，但其内部表征是否编码了这种社会粒度上的差异仍不清楚。我们发现了一条基于对比的“粒度轴”，即宏观角色与微观角色隐藏状态均值之间的差异方向，该轴与角色空间的主导几何结构高度对齐：在Qwen3-8B中，它与第一主成分（PC1）的余弦相似度为0.972，且PC1解释了52.6%的方差。在涵盖五个层级共75个角色的实验中，每个模型包含90,000条角色条件响应和1,200条默认响应，投影沿粒度单调递增，并在不同网络层、提示词及响应质量过滤条件下保持稳定。该结构可迁移至Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，并可扩展至Qwen3-32B和Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct，后两者的PC1方差占比分别为45.99%和31.23%。独立的五人评分验证（α=0.961）保持了这一排序；相同续写实验以及情感与正式度控制实验证实了该轴的尺度特异性。
tldr: 本文发现语言模型表征空间中存在一条“粒度轴”——宏观角色与微观角色隐藏状态均值的差异方向，该方向与角色空间的第一主成分高度对齐，并跨模型、角色层级、网络层和提示词稳定存在，证明模型内部编码了社会角色的粒度差异。
en_tdlr: The paper discovers a contrast-based "Granularity Axis" in language models—the latent direction between mean macro- and micro-role hidden states—which aligns with the dominant geometry of role space (PC1) and remains stable across models, role levels, layers, and prompts, showing that LLMs internally encode social role granularity.
